</p><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="font-size: 2em;"><b><span style="color: #333333;">Chen Ping’s Third
Strategy</span></b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<br />

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: x-large;"><i>Advising Liu Bang to Form an Alliance with the State of Qi Against
Xiang Yu</i></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><br /></span>

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">During
the Chu-Han Contention, after his victory at the Battle of Wei River,
Han Xin quickly took control of the Qi territories, and sent word to
Liu Bang of the victory, also requesting that he be made the new king
of Qi. At the time, however, Liu Bang was under siege by Xiang Yu in
Xingyang, eagerly awaiting reinforcements from Han Xin. When he
received Han Xin's request, he was furious, but eventually acted on
the advice of Chen Ping and approved Han Xin's request. This both
strengthened his relationship with Han Xin and made an </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><u>alliance</u></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">
with the state of Qi. Xiang Yu was worried after losing Long Ju </span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">(<span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">龙且</span></span>,
</span></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;">d. 204 B.C.<span style="text-decoration: none;">)</span><span style="text-decoration: none;">,
one of his top generals, in the </span><span style="text-decoration: none;">Battle
of Wei River</span><span style="text-decoration: none;">,
and sent word to Han Xin, trying to persuade him to rebel against Liu
Bang, and to declare himself King of Qi. Han Xin, however, refused to
betray Liu Bang, and later organized an army to move southward and
attack Xiang Yu </span><span style="text-decoration: none;">[18]</span><span style="text-decoration: none;">.</span></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><i><span style="font-weight: normal;">Advising
Liu Bang to Form an Alliance with the State of Qi Against </span></i></span><span style="color: #333333; font-family: inherit; font-size: large;"><i>Xiang
Yu </i><span style="font-style: normal;">is
an application of the 23rd stratagem, </span><i>Befriend
a Distant State While Attacking a Neighbor, </i><span style="font-style: normal;">and</span>
is associated with the 38th hexagram, <i>Fire
over Lake</i><i><span style="text-decoration: none;">
</span></i><span style="font-style: normal;"><span style="text-decoration: none;">[1],
[28]</span></span>.</span></p>

<span face="Noto Sans CJK SC Black, sans-serif" style="color: #333333; font-size: x-large;"><b>Sample Sentences 39:</b></span></p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><br />

</p>
<div dir="ltr" id="Section91" style="column-count: 2;"><p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
    1) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">那个公司的人力资源跟行政在吵架。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: That company’s
	human resources and administration are arguing.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	2) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">有的时候记者会当政治家。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="color: #333333; font-size: medium;">Trans.: Sometimes journalists
	become politicians.</span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	3) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">那个记者在哪一个媒体公司上班？</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	4) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我没有注意到他的方言，因为听起来和普</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;通话差不多。</span></span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	5) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">这里的环境被污染了。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	6) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我看不懂这个句子，能帮我翻译吗？</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	7) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">她有可能识别不了那么小的差异。</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><a name="tw-target-text27"></a></span></span>
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">
    8) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN"><span lang="zh-CN">我没有识别到是你，因为你刮了胡子。</span></span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	9)  <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我承诺了我的小孩，下个星期可以带他们</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;去大型体育场看足球比赛。</span></span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
	<span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333; text-decoration: none;">
    10) </span><span style="color: #0047AB !important; font-size: large">这两个国家什么时候结盟的？</span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	11) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">当工程师不太容易，你有没有什么策</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;略？</span></span></span></span></p>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	12) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">她不要当工程师的话，那她为什么学习</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;工程学？</span></span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<div class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-align: left; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	13) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">那个公司决定不聘用他，因为关于学历</span></span>
    <span>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;他撒了谎。</span></span></span></span></div>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;"><br /></span></span>
	<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;"><span style="font-size: large;"><span style="color: #333333;">
	14) <span style="font-family: Noto Sans CJK SC Regular;"><span lang="zh-CN">我识别不了这是不是谎话。</span></span></span></span></p>
</div>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in;"><br />

</p>
<p class="western" style="line-height: 100%; margin-bottom: 0in; text-decoration: none;">
<span style="color: #333333;">-------------------------------------</span></p>
